channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — Beschlüsse des Stadtrats Utrecht (Wohnen & Wohnbau)
channel.description: Beschlüsse und Dokumente des Stadtrats Utrecht in verständlicher Sprache erklärt.

item.title: TAM Environmental Plan Jan van Galenstraat
item.description: The college proposes to adopt the TAM environmental plan for Jan van Galenstraat, Huizingalaan, and Van Ginnekenlaan, which concerns the development of public space.

item.title: Adjustment Housing Ordinance
item.description: The college proposes to adjust the Housing Ordinance. This adjustment concerns the extension of the registration period for flow-through after temporary attention groups.

item.title: Change Environmental Plan
item.description: The college proposes to change the environmental plan for the Pijlsweerd, Lauwerecht, Vogelenbuurt, Staatsliedenbuurt, and Tuinwijk.

item.title: Adjustment Housing Ordinance
item.description: The city of Utrecht wants to adjust the Housing Ordinance. This means that people who live temporarily in a house will have more time to find a new home.

item.title: Adjustment Housing Ordinance
item.description: The city of Utrecht wants to adjust the Housing Ordinance. This is related to the registration period for progression after temporary attention groups.

item.title: Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026
item.description: The college of B and W proposes to the council to adopt the Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026. This perspective outlines how the municipality of Utrecht will deal with space in the coming years.

item.title: TAM Environmental Plan Jan van Galenstraat
item.description: The college of B and W proposes to the council to adopt the TAM Environmental Plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan.
